## Concept (one line)
A LinkedIn twist film: looks like an ordinary company (debate, chat,
presentation, founder review) → reveals it's all **AI agents** → the one human
is the **founder**. Ends: "This is how Kneaded.ai works."

## Locked decisions
- **Surprise structure:** Act 1 reads FULLY HUMAN (NO "agent/AI/Claude" labels);

## Gotchas
- This is ONE Claude session (`8372a238`), very long → **compaction** keeps
  eating context. That (not a rival session) caused the earlier "lost v1.5."
- "Other sessions" seen = CCC-spawned helper agents (Codex/Antigravity), not a
  parallel human session.
- Stale views on Claude Desktop/mobile = client sync lag; the terminal thread is
  authoritative. Trust file state + this STATE.md.
- **Critic model weighting:** Codex = heavier reasoner (trust for script/narrative
  logic). Antigravity = Gemini 3.5 Flash, a LIGHTER model (good for visual-spec
  legwork, but sanity-check its output; don't take timing/spatial precision as
  final). If its spec is thin, finish it myself rather than round-trip.
- CCC orchestration auto-nudges are OFF + CPU-hogged → user is pinging engines by
